title: Inverse proportion: more painters, fewer days
examples: If 1 painter takes 12 days, how long do 4 painters take?

explain.say: One painter takes 12 days to paint a school in Nairobi. Look at the first bar: 12 days. If 2 painters work together, will it take longer or shorter?

explain.say: Shorter! With 2 painters, each does half the work, so it takes 6 days. See the bar halve? When one amount doubles, the other halves. That is inverse proportion.

items.label: 3 painters
items.ask: How do you solve an inverse proportion problem?

explain.say: With 3 painters, it takes 4 days. Here is the secret: painters times days is always 12. 1 times 12, 2 times 6, 3 times 4. Can you find the days for 4 painters?

items.label: 3 painters

explain.say: On a graph, inverse proportion makes a curve. It falls fast, then flattens out. It never reaches zero days, because even a big team needs some time.

Great job! 6 painters need only 2 days. Wow: speed and time work this way too. Drive twice as fast and the trip takes half the time. Challenge: how many painters finish in 1 day, and would that really work?

items.label: 3 painters
items.ask: How do you solve an inverse proportion problem?

faq.a: When one amount doubles and the other halves, they are in inverse proportion. Multiply them and you always get the same number. Here painters times days is always 12.

faq.q: How do you solve an inverse proportion problem?
faq.a: Multiply to find the fixed total, then divide. 1 painter for 12 days is 12 painter-days. So 4 painters need 12 divided by 4, which is 3 days.

faq.q: What does an inverse proportion graph look like?
faq.a: It is a curve that falls steeply, then flattens. It gets closer and closer to the axes but never touches them.
asks: What shape is an inverse proportion graph?

faq.q: What is the difference between direct and inverse proportion?
faq.a: In direct proportion both amounts grow together, like chapatis and flour. In inverse proportion one grows while the other shrinks, like painters and days.

faq.q: How many painters would finish in 1 day?
faq.a: 12 painter-days divided by 1 day is 12 painters. In real life they might bump into each other, so maths models have limits.
asks: Can 12 painters finish in one day?

facts: In inverse proportion y = k ÷ x, so x times y always equals k.
For a fixed journey, speed and time are inversely proportional.

quiz.say: 5 taps fill a tank in 8 hours. How long do 10 taps take?
quiz.why: Double the taps means half the time, so 4 hours.

wrong.1: 16 hours treats it like direct proportion.

quiz.say: A trip takes 3 hours at 60 kilometres per hour. How long at 90 kilometres per hour?
quiz.why: The distance is 3 times 60, which is 180 kilometres. 180 divided by 90 is 2 hours.

wrong.1: 4.5 hours means going faster made the trip longer.
wrong.2: 1 hour needs a speed of 180 kilometres per hour.
